notes.text: The sheet specifies three topological spaces Sigma_0, Sigma_1, Sigma_2 and closed relations Sigma_01, Sigma_12, Sigma_02. It defines Sigma_012 by an intersection of products, then discusses a commutative diagram, injective/bordante maps, Cartesian squares, transversality and fibration conditions. The two marginal notes interpret the data as an order above [0,1,2] and propose a locally trivial three-object diagram over Sigma_0 as the proposed strengthening/replacement of f), with renforcer preferred and remplacer still possible. The first-reader pass records these source contents. The separate root checks in N07–N09 are conditional and set-theoretic; the geometric conditions d)–f) were not verified.

The first inclusion literally repeats Sigma_01 on both sides. H’s main text changes its right side to Sigma_0 times Sigma_1 and acknowledges that emendation in an editorial note. The literal self-inclusion is retained. The two neighbouring product inclusions and the later definition suggest the intended product, but that is an internal-source inference and is not substituted for the ink.

Condition c) literally states Sigma_012=Sigma_02 intersection Sigma_12 dans Sigma_12. The upper diagram arrows have common target Sigma_2. This comparison distinguishes the written dans Sigma_12 from the common space used to form the intersection after the b) identifications; it does not silently replace the written subscript. The root set-theoretic check is recorded separately in N09.

The continued b) target contains an overworked 0-shaped body before 2. Its state remains undecided between live 02 and a cancelled 0 followed by 2. The later et a fortiori map does not decide that ink. Root’s conditional injectivity check in N08 also shows that both target readings are compatible with the injectivity consequences, so mathematical coherence cannot establish a cancellation.

The singular phrase un morphisme bordant in d), singular fibrant in f), mixed delimiter (liss], and comma in the final Sigma_0,12 index are transcribed literally. The unexplained phrase after Cela remains doubtful, and the missing opening parenthesis is not supplied despite a written closing parenthesis.

This is a single foreground handwritten sheet. No authorial page number or written date is visible at its head. A thin lower-left 7 is recorded as foliation with indeterminate attribution. Apparent isolated W/delta forms in H belong to the complete rotated marginal note; faint show-through/paper specks are not transcribed.

Root targeted set-theoretic check of a), conditional on interpreting Sigma_01 as a relation in Sigma_0 times Sigma_1, and similarly the other Sigma_ij, as indicated by the later triple-product formula and diagram. The literal opening self-inclusion does not itself supply that hypothesis. On the disjoint union, adjoin only identities within each level and the indicated relations between increasing levels. Reflexivity then follows from the adjoined identities, and antisymmetry follows from strictly increasing grades for every nonidentity pair. The only possible composition of two nonidentity pairs is 0→1→2; its transitivity requirement is exactly a), the projection of Sigma_012 to (x0,x2) lying in Sigma_02.

Root targeted injectivity check, under the same relational/product interpretation and a) together with the injection hypotheses in b). Given (x1,x2), the injection Sigma_01→Sigma_1 determines x0, so Sigma_012→Sigma_12 is injective. Given (x0,x2), the injection Sigma_12→Sigma_2 determines x1, so Sigma_012→Sigma_02 is injective. Composing the latter map with the assumed injection Sigma_02→Sigma_2 gives injectivity of Sigma_012→Sigma_2. Thus the overworked target in the continued b) line cannot be decided between 02 and 2 by these mathematical consequences.

Root targeted set-theoretic check of the upper-square description, conditional on the same relational/product interpretation and the b) identifications of Sigma_02 and Sigma_12 as subsets of Sigma_2. Their set-theoretic fibre product over Sigma_2 is their intersection. The upper square is Cartesian as a square of sets exactly when its canonical Sigma_012 map identifies Sigma_012 with that intersection, as c) demands. This checks the formulation; it does not derive c) from a) and b), establish topological pullback identifications, or verify bordant, smooth, transversality, or fibration claims. The literal dans Sigma_12 remains unchanged.

Main reader inspected all ten nonidentical independent targets. The lower marginal verb now favors renforcer; the short phrase after Cela remains unresolved. The third upper f) source has a comma in 1,2. Locally incomplete arrowheads and the chevron on the broken central-diagram stroke are recorded from the ink, without changing the conditional mathematical checks in N07–N09.
